value: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing inpatient nursing and rehabilitative services. The care is generally provided for an extended period of time to individuals requiring nursing care. These establishments have a permanent core staff of registered or licensed practical nurses who, along with other staff, provide nursing and continuous personal care services.
Assisted living facilities (without nursing facilities) for the elderly with nursing care
Convalescent homes or convalescent hospitals (except psychiatric)
Group homes for the disabled with nursing care
Homes for the aged with nursing care
Homes for the elderly with nursing care
